inclusion: Expanded modeled population: all 165122 status=Traced rows plus2000 annotated non-tbc status=null rows. Of the latter,1991 are explicitly statusLabel=Out of scope (1982 R1-R6 ol_sensory and9 ol_intrinsic), and9 lack a statusLabel. These are intentionally included measured segments, not claimed officially traced. Excludes glia/orphans/anchors/assign/unimportant. Runtime is a selected, edge-thresholded CNS model, not the full unfiltered neuron graph.
dynamics: Authored LIF; predicted GABA/glutamate negative, others/unknown positive; sensory superclass stimulation (8 channels, drive .02+.55·input, was .10+.40 before 2026-09-14); reward/feeding channel (input 8) into all 1,428 class=gustatory neurons (see gustatory.json); seeded initial membrane state per brain; cb_motor and vnc_motor output; not physiological validation

priorFlyWireWeightAudit.note: MaleCNS >=5 is not strictly the same retained-weight threshold as prior FlyWire. Prior builder aggregates signed neuropil weights, retaining nonzero weights; this audit measures the resulting binary.

rewardChannel.note: Authored input mapping of a reward signal (Vina-derived, learned-preference-weighted) into annotated gustatory receptor neurons; not a physiological feeding model.
